record_notes.DCP-LETT-2397: Four blocks and full metadata/XML, seven footnotes and bibliography read. March 30, 1858 is supplied and month questioned. Darwin has returned Huxley manuscript through Lubbock and seeks confirmation against loss. His criticisms of Owen discussion, human comparison and epidermic babies concern Huxley paper, not the editorial summary suggested later Lubbock Chloëon paper. Separate private Busk letter and Lubbock note to Huxley are missing; published text omits the babies sentence. Later printed article does not establish exact submitted manuscript wording.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2284: Four retained blocks, complete metadata/XML, two notes and bibliography read; actual preserved two-part Coccus diagram viewed. June 10, 1858. Thanks for queen-bee larva and pupa, useful some day, not work already completed. Figure contrasts C. persicae questioned identification and C. hesperidum ganglion shapes, with a and b labelled branches. P3 reports some specimens in both species with a arising directly from ganglion rather than b; no count or universal prevalence. Later Origin citation does not supply an exact Darwin receipt. Terminal C Darwin Esq is address, not Lubbock prose.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2390: Six blocks, all metadata, four notes and bibliography read. Supplied August–September 1858, despite manuscript endorsement 1859; editorial rationale uses flowering season and pre-October chapter composition, not an exact Sunday. Correlation of unmarked central Pelargonium flowers, reduced nectary and modified calyx is Darwin observation prompted by recalled conversation/Lady Lubbock observation, not a surviving incoming letter. Two actual flower parcels sent as comparison and further trusses requested; requests are not new results. Swammerdam sent this morning, not first read then.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2331: Seven blocks, full metadata, nine notes and bibliography read. November 1858 Sunday is supplied from manuscript abstract history; exact day unresolved. Manuscript abstract praised and marked, with ambiguity/terminology advice, separate from revised published abstract. Tropical aphids are queried against incidental Lund information, not established absent worldwide. John William Lubbock well note answered through Parslow; remembered chalk-water paper author is forgotten and Prestwich identification only editorial candidate. Nicholson bee letter unsuitable for quotation and not preserved here; no substitute prompt manufactured. Literal thougt and line-break artifacts require evidenced derivative review.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2408: Five blocks, metadata/XML, seven notes and bibliography read. Supplied Sunday February 6, 1859 supported by Moor Park arrival and February 8 reply. Receives Lubbock note for Wollaston before starting, will add and forward; current dispatch is still planned. Requests brother injury update, reports Henrietta illness and own attacks. P5 explicitly proposes a paper on internal organs of anomalous insects, with organs and taxa listed; it supplies the surviving February 8 response. Missing earlier note is not reconstructed.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2409: Two surviving blocks, complete metadata/XML, three footnotes, annotations and bibliography read. February 8, 1859 incoming fragment ends mid-sentence animals so; original continuation is absent. P1 replies to health news and requested Beaumont injury update; saving half a finger joint is a hope. P2 thanks for proposed internal-anatomy paper and raises ovarian differences in apparently allied earwigs as a challenge, Dufour reported rather than Lubbock direct observation for Labidoura. Undated Ch. 8 annotation supplies no independent receipt date. Falconer, Builder and instinct portions possibly in missing continuation cannot be filled from Darwin later reply.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2411: Five blocks, all metadata/XML and six notes read. February 9 supplied 1859 is the only February Moor Park stay. P1 first two sentences acknowledge note and brother news; Falconer joke is not preserved in incoming 2409. P2 Builder request and P3 first instinct sentence also lack surviving direct antecedent. P3 second sentence explicitly answers the important-organ differences in 2409, admits serious difficulty and reliance on unknown correlations. P4 closing is Darwin text. P5 Wollaston dispatch now completed, but forwarded letter is missing and separate from 2409 surviving text.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2426: Six blocks, full metadata/XML, six notes and bibliography read. March 8 supplied 1859. Asks for insect embryology lacking vermiform stage, with tentative Dufour memory and Aphis alternative, acknowledges uncertainty and prefers dipteran case. March 15 reply supplies specific correction. London wishes and Farnborough railway query are separate topics; future railway failure is editorial later outcome. Willingness to help in missing continuation of February 8 is not a surviving standalone prompt.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2433: Five blocks, metadata/XML, five notes, Darwin annotations and bibliography read. March 15, 1859. Saturday visit is planned; identifies Kölliker Chironomus and Leuckart Melophagus, both beginning apod grub, and says Aphis likewise. Distinguishes appendages/segments order, larva versus pupa terminology, metamorphosis in ovo, and unusual Meloe/Sitaris stages. States personal view and uncertainty about understanding Darwin question. Undated must strike out Dufour annotation is later Darwin research layer, excluded from incoming text. Surviving scientific answer directly addresses 2426 P2–3.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2434: Five blocks, metadata/XML, three notes and bibliography read. March 16 supplied 1859 from March 15 source. Explicitly thanks useful note and admits Aphis error; agrees to proposed Saturday subject to health. Rediscovered own manuscript reference to Dufour gives cautious quoted/paraphrased contrary evidence, asks Lubbock to check for meeting. This is a direct follow-up to 2433, not evidence the new check or meeting occurred. Body cites Annales 1845, not the distinct Comptes rendus item named by editorial summary.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2419: Eight blocks, metadata/XML, nine notes and bibliography read. Supplied March 21, 1859 despite lower catalogue ID. After proposed Saturday meeting, reopens Aphis issue from inspected Huxley plates while explicitly not reading the text to spare brain. Earlier contrary Lubbock opinion matches 2433 but possible intervening oral exchange prevents inventing a unique new prompt. P1 publications returned/sent, P2 loan requested, P5 missing Wollaston letter read and joint letter sent earlier; none equates the sources. Strong evidence needed for continuous island union. P8 cirripede correction admits speculation. No new direct edge beyond established March 16 reply.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2527: Five blocks, full metadata/XML, four notes and bibliography read. Supplied November 19, 1859 is questionable at exact-day level: footnote says the Saturday following November 11 was November 19, but calendar gives November 12. Preserve editorial date and add exact-date hold, not an automatic redate. Phillips explanation deferred until return; missing Lubbock invitation/query not reconstructed. Murray was instructed to send book but Lubbock has not received it. Secondary-cause thunder analogy is authorial reasoning, not an incoming quotation. Broad pre-departure chronology remains distinct from exact day.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2532: Four blocks, metadata/XML, three notes and bibliography read. Supplied November 22 depends on assumed November 19 preceding letter. Apparatus rejects Freeman November 15, yet November 12/15 also satisfies stated Saturday/Tuesday sequence; exact-day hold records unresolved basis without overriding source. Emma presence and November 24 departure give outer context, not proof of one Tuesday. Explicitly declines Brighton invitation after misunderstanding, recalls former admiration of Paley, and now acknowledges Lubbock got the book. No surviving current inbound note or exact receipt day.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2584: Six blocks, metadata/XML, eight notes and bibliography read; actual currency markup inspected. December 14 after endpoint. Returned Friday, saw Phillips Monday; full school trust memorandum and bill said enclosed are missing. Currency raw strings 10110,11 0,550,220 are plain text, not MathML, and cannot be silently interpreted as decimal numbers. Later 2586 accounts corroborate some pound/shilling/pence amounts. Rent inquiry, Friendly Club deduction and draft are proposed. Reprint 3000 copies and Kingsley quotation permission are December knowledge; no backdating to November 18 composition of Kingsley source.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2586: Five blocks plus all nine actual enclosure paragraphs, metadata/XML and seven notes read; original enclosure markup inspected. December 17 after endpoint. Draft/account memorandum sent; Sunday-school Cranworth amount excluded and Lady Lubbock amount separately paid. Authorial account rows preserve £10 1s 10d, £1 1s, £5 5s, rent £2 7s 1d, total £18 14s 11d, less 10s to £18 4s 11d; split rent request is one continuous item, no HTML table exists. Incomplete Farewell till we is an authorial unfinished sentence, not to complete synthetically. Missing Lubbock conversion note does not become pre-cutoff knowledge. Rifle club and proposed London visit remain separate.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2123: Explicit accepted primary full-source reading reused after matching note, ledger and source hashes. 14, supplied July1857; seven blocks, three notes and bibliography read. Lubbock’s correction came through explicitly identified conversation, not a surviving letter. New Zealand counts339species/51variable versus323/37, expected48½ with genuine MathML; ratio includes raw backslash-colon commands requiring supported formatting cleanup. Darwin’s previous method repudiated, current effect qualified as weak absent generality. Recalculation for weeks still future, not completed. Do not turn modern footnote explanation into Darwin’s own statistical prose.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2481: Explicit accepted primary full-source reading reused after matching note, ledger and source hashes. August11, supplied1857; four blocks, three notes and bibliography read. Refuses Thursday visit because old friend expected; later invitation2396 changes plan. Heard yesterday of visit, not necessarily August5 Henslow letter newly delivered yesterday. Chinese fowl answer deferred until conversation, Bromley trip undecided. Yesterday’s Crystal Palace show unhelpful; no new specimen received.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2396: Explicit accepted primary full-source reading reused after matching note, ledger and source hashes. 12, supplied August1857; three blocks and three notes read. Reverses previous day by inviting Lubbock to meet Henslow Thursday. Actual MathML7¼ dinner and½hour rest, not714 or12. Emma called away, possible next-day return uncertain; later death September11 is editorial future. Invitation is not proof of attendance and no answer required.
record_notes.DCP-LETT-2149: Explicit accepted primary full-source reading reused after matching note, ledger and source hashes. Sunday morning supplied November22,1857; three blocks and four notes read. Reports overheard Sharpey/Huxley praise at previousThursday Philosophical Club, not written incoming correspondence. Encourages possible Royal Society candidacy and does not know whether already proposed; actual1858 election excluded from contemporary certainty. Declines sister’s wedding breakfast despite thanks; missing invitation not reconstructed.

visual_readings.visual_observation: Root viewed the actual preserved diagram. Two panels numbered 1 and 2, labelled C. persicae? and C. hesperidum. Left posterior ganglion tapers into trident-like central stem and lateral nerves; right has a rounded termination with separate long central and lateral lines. Both show branches a and b. Figure supports the topological comparison, not a quantitative size or sample count, and preserves the questioned left identification.

reading_method: Root independently read complete surviving new source bodies, metadata constraints, exclusions, footnotes, scholarly sections and bibliography. Actual special markup and figures inspected where present. Reused explicit accepted primary readings only after matching source and accepted evidence hashes. Historical decisions and notes are handwritten; validation packages evidence rather than adjudicating it.
